text: all being considered, get me the exact styles in place for things like container widths, column widths, text input widths, etc.
resolution: Added an Exact Style Values section to cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/STUDIO_MESH_EDITOR_FEATURE_COVERAGE.md. It records the concrete style numbers currently in force across the shared workbench shell and the Studio mesh editor: gutter and column widths, text input widths/heights, viewport chrome offsets, context rail widths, outliner and paint layer row dimensions, modal card widths, backdrop panel measurements, offscreen texture sizes, and the Studio tunables that control visible grid/camera/editing scale. This makes the previous feature and ASCII layout coverage directly actionable when adjusting layout or comparing current behavior against future UI changes.
